Procurement

Learn how to do business with the City through its procurement process. Find information on purchasing opportunities, bids and tenders, vendor requirements, and procurement policies.

Finding bid opportunities

City of Orillia bid opportunities are posted on the City’s electronic bidding system:

Find the City's bid opportunities

Tender alerts

Vendors who are interested in providing goods and services to the City of Orillia need to create an account on Bids and Tenders to automatically receive tender alerts. Vendors will receive an automatic email notification from Bids and Tenders when the City has posted a bid opportunity that is relevant to the vendor’s business.

Contact Bids and Tenders:
1-800-594-4798 
support@bidsandtenders.ca
